// Fixture for the saveactions lint: every Save call carries an action.
// Should produce zero findings.
//
// Stored as .go.txt so `go test` and `go build` skip it -- only the
// lint reads it via parser.ParseFile against the .go content.
package fixtures

import "github.com/gramaton-ai/gramaton/graph"

type engineLike struct{}

func (e *engineLike) Save(message string, actions ...graph.CommitAction) error { return nil }
func (e *engineLike) SaveOrLog(message string, actions ...graph.CommitAction)  {}

func WithAction(e *engineLike) {
	_ = e.Save("op", graph.CommitAction{Kind: "x", RecordID: "1"})
}

func WithSaveOrLog(e *engineLike) {
	e.SaveOrLog("op", graph.CommitAction{Kind: "x", RecordID: "1"})
}

func WithVariadicSpread(e *engineLike) {
	actions := []graph.CommitAction{{Kind: "x"}}
	_ = e.Save("op", actions...)
}
